QUOTE: the docs use the measured Mbed-TLS case to show that honouring its `INPUT` indexed 1,571 headers and none of the 108 `library/*.c` implementations. ... It no longer supplies `INPUT`. The Doxyfile is only a documentation target
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the Doxyfile INPUT is no longer used and gives the Mbed-TLS example. It never states the item's rationale: a repo that ships a Doxyfile would get only its documented subset, while a repo that ships none gets its whole tree.
